title: The US FCC approves Amazon Leo's $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar, giving Amazon access to Globalstar's 24 satellites and mobile satellite spectrum (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: The US FCC approves Amazon Leo's $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar, giving Amazon access to Globalstar's 24 satellites and mobile satellite spectrum — The Federal Communications Commission said on Tuesday it approved Amazon (AMZN.O) Leo's $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar (GSAT.O) …
